# Bundled fonts

InkWisp bundles these unmodified fonts:

- **LXGW WenKai Lite Regular** from `lxgw/LxgwWenKai-Lite`, used for Chinese UI and Markdown text. Licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `lxgw-wenkai-lite/OFL.txt`.
- **Newsreader Variable** from Google Fonts / Production Type, used for English UI and Markdown text. Licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `newsreader/OFL.txt`.

The font licenses apply to the font files. InkWisp source code remains MIT licensed.
